F2 withdrawn: checked inspectColorPrint at d06690a0 (git show d06690a0:src/storytime/muse-delivery.ts). It refuses a palette PNG (metadata.isPalette), a depth other than uchar or bitsPerSample other than 8, a space other than srgb, and a channel count other than 3, on top of the existing PNG format, pixel size, and no-alpha checks. Workbooks checkColor (dashboard/lib/storytime/print/picture-check.ts:238-250) requires PNG format, no alpha, no 4 channels, channels === 3, and space srgb or rgb. The writer covers every rule and adds the palette refusal; it accepts only srgb, which sharp reports for an 8-bit RGB PNG, so the Muse flow sees no false refusal. Test T171 covers palette, one-channel, 16-bit, and four-channel refusals.

F3 withdrawn: checked writeMuseDelivery at d06690a0. The items loop calls options.onSkip(row.id, 'The approval list has no entry for <row id>; the row is not clean and gets no job.') for each row with no approval entry. The deliver command wires it: onSkip: (rowId, reason) => log(`Skipped ${rowId}: ${reason}`) at src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:4744. Test T172 reports a row that has no approval entry.

Manifest shape unchanged: StorytimeManifest at src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:238-243 stays version 1, batchHashAlgorithm, jobs, batches. The diff 19359dd1..d06690a0 in book-pictures.ts touches only the deliver command block (adds resolveMuseDeliveryPaths, pictureListSha256, onSkip). muse-delivery.ts still builds the manifest through assembleManifest and manifestJob (directory w01). This matches spec.md amendment 2026-11-01 decision 2.

Operator clarity: pictureListSha256 is an optional approval-list field with a 64-hex regex; a mismatch names the measured hash and the pin, and a pin with no measured hash names that case. resolveMuseDeliveryPaths refuses a --muse or --delivery path outside <repoRoot>/out and names the flag, the required folder, and the got path. readMuseFile errors name the row, the file, and the reason (symlink, outside the Muse folder, not a regular file). Copy refusals name the row, the file, and the reason. Tests T162, T163, and T164 cover the pin and the path rule.

Exit codes: the deliver command returns 0 after it writes the delivery (src/storytime/book-pictures.ts, deliver block). A refusal throws; the RB2-01 boundary catches it, redacts it, logs it, and returns 1 (scripts/storytime-book-pictures.ts:48-56). The production entry sets process.exitCode from that return (scripts/storytime-book-pictures.ts:91-97).
